<!-- Included by report.qmd. Regional contributions to the total biomass (IID) index. -->

## Regional contributions to the index {#sec-regional}

```{r region}
reg <- if (!is.null(post[[total]])) post[[total]]$region
division_of <- function(x) sub("^27\\.([0-9])\\.([a-z]).*$", "\\1.\\2", x)
haul_div <- dt |>
  dplyr::mutate(region = division_of(icesarea)) |>
  dplyr::count(year, region, name = "hauls")
if (!is.null(reg)) {
  reg_tab <- tibble::as_tibble(unclass(reg))
  reg_mean <- reg_tab |> dplyr::summarise(share = mean(share), .by = "region") |> dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(share))
  reg_cor <- reg_tab |>
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::summarise(reg_tab, tot = sum(est), .by = "year"), by = "year") |>
    dplyr::summarise(r = stats::cor(log(est), log(tot)), .by = "region")
  first_last <- reg_tab |>
    dplyr::summarise(early = mean(share[year < min(year) + 5]), late = mean(share[year > max(year) - 5]), .by = "region")
}
```

The total biomass index is the sum of the predicted biomass over the grid cells, so it can be split by area without refitting. The cells were assigned to ICES divisions with the ICES area polygons that the survey selection uses, and the predicted biomass (without the bias correction) was summed by division and year (`sdmTMBexperiments::index_by_region()`). The split shows which areas carry the index and whether its trend comes from one area or from all of them, which matters because the survey coverage of the areas differs between series and years.

`r if (!is.null(reg)) paste0("Division ", reg_mean$region[1], " holds on average ", pct(reg_mean$share[1]), " of the index, ", list_values(paste0(reg_mean$region[-1], " ", pct(reg_mean$share[-1]))), " (@fig-report-region). The share of ", reg_mean$region[1], " was ", pct(first_last$early[first_last$region == reg_mean$region[1]]), " in the first five years and ", pct(first_last$late[first_last$region == reg_mean$region[1]]), " in the last five. The log index of each division correlates with the log total index by r = ", paste0(sprintf("%.2f", reg_cor$r), " (", reg_cor$region, ")", collapse = ", "), ".") else "The regional split has not been computed yet."`

```{r}
#| label: fig-report-region
#| eval: !expr '!is.null(reg)'
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: !expr 'paste0("Regional composition of the total biomass (IID) index of ", sp_lc, " by ICES division. A) Share of the index in each division by year. B) The index of each division divided by its own mean. C) Number of hauls in each division by year.")'
div_cols <- stats::setNames(c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#CC79A7", "#0072B2", "#D55E00")[seq_along(unique(reg_tab$region))],
                            sort(unique(c(reg_tab$region, haul_div$region))))
a <- ggplot2::ggplot(reg_tab, ggplot2::aes(year, share, fill = region)) +
  ggplot2::geom_area(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = div_cols) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Share of index", fill = "Division") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
b <- ggplot2::ggplot(reg_tab, ggplot2::aes(year, rel_mean, colour = region)) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +
  ggplot2::geom_line() + ggplot2::geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = div_cols) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Index / mean", colour = "Division") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
c <- ggplot2::ggplot(haul_div, ggplot2::aes(year, hauls, fill = region)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = div_cols) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Hauls", fill = "Division") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9) + ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
cowplot::plot_grid(a, b, c, ncol = 1, labels = "AUTO", rel_heights = c(1, 1, 1.25), align = "v", axis = "lr")
```
